answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like a river that only flows after a dam holds water: the stake is checked on every transaction, and misbehavior slashes it. A single raven cannot fake a flock, because creating many identities multiplies the locked capital and the shale-thin margin of a Sybil farm collapses when one bad attestation burns deposits across all its linked accounts, making fraud cost more than any reward it could extract.
